description:
PROTOCOL DESCRIPTION
====================

Title        : Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and Droplet Digital PCR (ddPCR) Protocol
Authors      : Katie Jing Kay Lam, Olubankole Arogundade, Claire Clelland
Affiliations : Weill Institute for Neurosciences, University of California, San Francisco, USA
               Department of Neurology, University of California, San Francisco, CA, USA
Contact      : claire.clelland@ucsf.edu
Source Link  : https://www.protocols.io/view/droplet-digital-pcr-ddpcr-kqdg3244ev25/v1
DOI Link     : https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kqdg3244ev25/v1
Platform     : Benchtop PCR (Bio-Rad Thermal Cycler) + Droplet Digital PCR (Bio-Rad QX200 system)


OVERVIEW
--------
This protocol covers two sequential, complementary molecular biology workflows:

  1. Standard PCR: DNA amplification from cultured mammalian cells extracted with QuickExtract,
     followed by gel electrophoresis QC on a Bio-Rad Sub-Cell GT system and fluorescence imaging
     on a LI-COR Odyssey M imager.

  2. Droplet Digital PCR (ddPCR): absolute quantification of target DNA copy number using a
     Bio-Rad QX200 Droplet Generator and Droplet Reader, with a two-channel FAM/HEX probe
     design (target gene + RPP30 reference). ddPCR partitions the PCR reaction into ~20,000
     nanodroplets (~0.85 nL each), enabling Poisson-statistics-based absolute counting of
     positive (target-containing) vs. negative (empty) droplets without a standard curve.

An optional gel extraction module (Qiagen MinElute, modified) is included for downstream
sequencing applications requiring a larger 50 uL PCR reaction.

The BioScript encoding covers both workflows in a single file with a linear-sequential
structure: DNA extraction → PCR → gel QC gate (BB1-BB4) → ddPCR → droplet readout gate
(BB4-BB7). A total of 7 basic blocks and 2 if/else QC gates are generated.


PROTOCOL 1: STANDARD PCR
-------------------------

Step 1 | DNA Preparation by QuickExtract (96-well plate)
  Reagents   : PBS, QuickExtract DNA Extraction Solution (Biosearch Technologies, 76081-768)
  Operations :
    1. Wash cells with 100 uL PBS per well; aspirate.
    2. Add 30 uL QuickExtract per well.
    3. Scrape well bottom with pipette tip to detach cells.
    4. Transfer cells to labelled PCR tubes.
    5. Vortex 15 s.
    6. Incubate at 65 C for 6 min.
    7. Vortex 15 s.
    8. Incubate at 98 C for 2 min.
    9. Store at -20 C.
  Output     : PCR-ready DNA template (direct lysis, no column purification required)

Step 2 | Primer Preparation
  Working stock : 10 uM (diluted from 100 uM IDT stock)
  Preparation   :
    - Resuspend IDT lyophilised primers in H2O to 100 uM (e.g. 20 nmol -> add 200 uL H2O).
    - Dilute to 10 uM working stock in new microcentrifuge tube (20 uL + 180 uL H2O).
    - Store at -20 C.
  Design guidelines (PCR primers):
    - Length: 18-30 bases (~20 optimal); GC content: 40-60%.
    - 3' end should be G or C; avoid >3 consecutive G/C repeats.
    - Tm: 50-65 C; primer pairs within 5 C of each other.
    - Product length: 200-1000 bp (up to 2-3 kb if needed).
    - Tools: Primer-BLAST (NCBI), Primer3web, OligoCalc (Properties Calculator).
    - Order from IDT as Custom DNA oligos.

Step 3 | PCR Reaction Setup (20 uL)
  Master Mix for one 20 uL reaction:
    BioMix Red (Meridian Life Sciences, C755F25)     10.0 uL
    DMSO (Sigma Aldrich, D8418)                       0.6 uL
    Forward primer (10 uM)                            1.0 uL
    Reverse primer (10 uM)                            1.0 uL
    RNase/DNase-free H2O                              6.4 uL
    ------------------------------------------------ -------
    Total Master Mix                                 19.0 uL
    + 1 uL DNA template per tube                  -> 20 uL

  Setup: prepare Master Mix for (number of reactions + 1) as extra.
  Load into Bio-Rad Thermal Cycler.

  PCR for sequencing (with gel extraction): use 50 uL reaction; 2.5 uL DNA + 47 uL Master Mix.
    BioMix Red 25 uL | DMSO 1.5 uL | Fwd primer 2.5 uL | Rev primer 2.5 uL | H2O 16 uL.

Step 4 | PCR Thermocycling (Bio-Rad Thermal Cycler)
  Step | Name                 | Temperature | Time
  -----+----------------------+-------------+----------
    1  | Enzyme Activation    | 94 C        | 3 min
    2  | Denaturation         | 94 C        | 30 s
    3  | Annealing            | 50-65 C*    | 30 s
    4  | Primary Extension    | 72 C        | 1 min/kb
    5  | Repeat steps 2-4     | --          | x34
    6  | Secondary Extension  | 72 C        | 5 min
    7  | Hold                 | 4 C         | infinity
  *Annealing temperature: 5-10 C below primer Tm.

  PCR for sequencing cycle (39 amplification cycles, 50 uL reaction):
    Enzyme Activation 94 C 3.5 min -> Denature 94 C 45 s -> Anneal 50-65 C 45 s ->
    Extend 72 C 1 min/kb -> x39 -> Secondary Extension 72 C 5 min -> Hold 4 C.

Step 5 | Gel Electrophoresis
  Buffer preparation:
    1X TAE: add 36 mL 50X TAE Buffer (Thermo Scientific, B49) to 2L bottle; add diH2O to 1800 mL.

  Gel preparation (1.5-2% agarose):
    - For 150 mL gel: weigh agarose (e.g. 2 g for 2% in 100 mL 1X TAE).
    - Heat in microwave until completely dissolved; let cool slightly.
    - Add 15 uL SYBR Safe DNA Gel Stain (Invitrogen, S33102) per 150 mL gel.
    - Pour onto tray; remove bubbles; place 15 or 20-well comb; let solidify.
    - NOTE: clean and rinse beaker after every use; do NOT discard excess gel in sink.

  Running the gel:
    - Place solidified gel in Bio-Rad Sub-Cell GT Cell; wells at negative (black) terminal.
    - Fill with 1X TAE buffer until gel is fully submerged.
    - Load ~12 uL Quick-Load Purple 1 kb Plus DNA Ladder (NEB, N0550S) and PCR products.
      Submerge pipette tip into well before dispensing; press only to first stop to avoid bubbles.
    - Set Bio-Rad PowerPac Power Supply to 100-140 V (Black to Black; Red to Red); START.
    - Run until bands resolved (~40 min typical).

  Gel imaging (LI-COR Odyssey M Imager):
    - Clean imager glass with EtOH and Kimwipe before and after each use.
    - Open LI-COR Acquisition Software.
    - Select: Scan -> Username: Clelland Lab -> Imager: Odyssey M -> Connect.
    - Select: Gel -> Connect -> Draw Scan Area -> Next.
    - Select: 488 / SYBR Safe -> Save -> Focus offset 2.00 mm -> Scan.
    - Wait for scan to finish; export image to desired destination.


PROTOCOL 2: DROPLET DIGITAL PCR (ddPCR)
-----------------------------------------
Instrument: Bio-Rad QX200 Droplet Generator + Droplet Reader.
NOTE: Schedule equipment at CAT on iLab before proceeding.

Step 6 | 20X Target Primers/Probe Preparation
  Component                     Volume
  Forward primer (100 uM)       18 uL
  Reverse primer (100 uM)       18 uL
  Target probe (FAM)*            5 uL
  RNase/DNase-free H2O          59 uL
  Total                        100 uL
  *Light sensitive. Store all at -20 C.

  Design guidelines (ddPCR probes):
    - Between primer pair; no overlap with primers.
    - Length: <30 bases; Tm: 3-10 C above primers.
    - More Cs than Gs; no G at 5' end.
    - Product length: 50-250 bp (optimal 80-120 bp).
    - Order from IDT as PrimeTime qPCR Probes (5' FAM/ZEN/3' Iowa Black FQ).

Step 7 | ddPCR Master Mix Setup (22 uL per reaction)
  Component                                          Volume
  2X ddPCR Supermix for Probes (No dUTP, Bio-Rad)   11.0 uL
  20X target primers/probe (FAM)                      1.1 uL
  20X reference primers/probe (HEX/VIC) - RPP30       1.1 uL
  RNase/DNase-free H2O + DNA sample           up to 22.0 uL
  DNA input: up to 350 ng per reaction.

  Reference assay: ddPCR Copy Number Assay RPP30, Human, Homo sapiens
                   (Bio-Rad, dHsaCP1000485; HEX/VIC channel; Ch 2 Reference).
  Setup: thaw all components to room temperature; vortex at full speed 15 s when mixing.
  Prepare Master Mix for (number of reactions + 1).

Step 8 | Droplet Generation (Bio-Rad QX200 Droplet Generator)
  1. Insert DG8 Cartridge (Bio-Rad, 1864008) into cartridge holder (Bio-Rad, 1863051).
  2. FIRST: load >20 uL sample into sample wells.
     - Empty wells: add 50:50 mix of Supermix and H2O. All 8 wells must be loaded.
     - No bubbles.
  3. THEN: load 70 uL Droplet Generation Oil for Probes (Bio-Rad, 1863005) into oil wells.
     - Oil is single-use; use within one day of opening.
  4. Apply DG8 Gasket (Bio-Rad, 1863009) on cartridge.
  5. Load cartridge into QX200 Droplet Generator; START (~1 min).

Step 9 | Droplet Transfer and Plate Sealing (within 5 min of generation)
  1. Transfer 40 uL droplets to ddPCR 96-Well Plates (Bio-Rad, 12001925).
     - Pipette SLOWLY: >7 s for aspiration and dispensing to preserve droplet integrity.
  2. Cover plate with foil seal sheet (PCR Plate Heat Seal, pierceable; Bio-Rad, 1814040).
     - Red line facing UP.
  3. Seal plate in PX1 PCR Plate Sealer (Bio-Rad, 1814000) at 180 C for 5 s.

Step 10 | ddPCR Thermocycling (within 40 min of sealing)
  Instrument: Bio-Rad C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler with 96-Deep Well C1000 block (Bio-Rad, 1851197).
  Ramp rate: 2 C/s throughout.

  Step | Name                   | Temperature | Time
  -----+------------------------+-------------+---------
    1  | Enzyme Activation      | 94 C        | 10 min
    2  | Denaturation           | 94 C        | 30 s
    3  | Annealing/Extension    | *50-65 C    | 1 min
    4  | Repeat steps 2-3       | --          | x39
    5  | Enzyme Deactivation    | 98 C        | 10 min
    6  | Hold                   | 4 C         | infinity
  *Optimise annealing temperature using gradient when using a new primers/probe set.

Step 11 | Plate Reading and Data Analysis (Bio-Rad QX200 Droplet Reader)
  1. Let plate equilibrate at room temperature for 1-2 min.
     (Plate storable at 4 C for up to 3 days before reading.)
  2. Place plate in Bio-Rad QX200 Droplet Reader.
  3. Open QuantaSoft; configure each well:
     - Sample: enter name; Experiment: CNV2; Supermix: ddPCR Supermix for Probes (no dUTP).
     - Target 1 (FAM):     enter name; Type: Ch 1 Unknown.
     - Target 2 (HEX/VIC): enter name (e.g. RPP30); Type: Ch 2 Reference.
     - NOTE: copy and paste configuration for every well in the plate.
  4. Save template; RUN.
  5. Data analysis: set threshold manually (pink line); ensure positive droplets (blue/green)
     are separated from negative droplets (grey). See 2-D and 1-D droplet plots.


REAGENT AND EQUIPMENT LIST
---------------------------

Reagents:
  QuickExtract DNA Extraction Solution  |  Biosearch Technologies  |  76081-768
  BioMix Red                            |  Meridian Life Sciences  |  C755F25
  DMSO (Dimethyl sulfoxide)             |  Sigma Aldrich / Biosciences  |  D8418
  Quick-Load Purple 1 kb Plus DNA Ladder|  New England Biolabs     |  N0550S
  SYBR Safe DNA Gel Stain               |  Invitrogen              |  S33102
  TAE Buffer (Tris-acetate-EDTA) 50X    |  Thermo Scientific       |  B49
  ddPCR Copy Number Assay RPP30 (Human) |  Bio-Rad                 |  dHsaCP1000485
  ddPCR Supermix for Probes (No dUTP)   |  Bio-Rad                 |  1863024
  Droplet Generation Oil for Probes     |  Bio-Rad                 |  1863005

Equipment / Consumables:
  Bio-Rad Thermal Cycler                          |  Bio-Rad
  LI-COR Odyssey M Imager                         |  LI-COR
  PowerPac HC Power Supply                        |  Bio-Rad
  Sub-Cell GT Horizontal Electrophoresis System   |  Bio-Rad
  C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler 96-Deep Well Module  |  Bio-Rad  |  1851197
  ddPCR 96-Well Plates                            |  Bio-Rad  |  12001925
  DG8 Cartridges                                  |  Bio-Rad  |  1864008
  DG8 Cartridge Holder                            |  Bio-Rad  |  1863051
  DG8 Gaskets                                     |  Bio-Rad  |  1863009
  PCR Plate Heat Seal, foil, pierceable           |  Bio-Rad  |  1814040
  PX1 PCR Plate Sealer                            |  Bio-Rad  |  1814000
  QX200 Droplet Digital PCR System                |  Bio-Rad


BIOSCRIPT COMPILER NOTES
-------------------------
BioScript file  : clelland_pcr_ddpcr.bs
Compiler        : lilott8/BioScript (ANTLR4-based)
IR output file  : clelland_pcr_ddpcr.ir
DAG output file : clelland_pcr_ddpcr_main_dag.dot
Basic blocks    : 7 (BB1-BB7); 2 if/else QC gates; 8 CFG edges

Duration tokens: BioScript supports s (seconds) and m (minutes) only; h token not supported.
  QuickExtract 65 C 6 min        ->  6m   (IR: 360.0 SECOND)
  QuickExtract 98 C 2 min        ->  2m   (IR: 120.0 SECOND)
  PCR enzyme activation 3 min    ->  3m   (IR: 180.0 SECOND)
  PCR final extension 5 min      ->  5m   (IR: 300.0 SECOND)
  Gel electrophoresis run 40 min ->  40m  (IR: 2400.0 SECOND)
  ddPCR enzyme activation 10 min ->  10m  (IR: 600.0 SECOND)
  ddPCR enzyme deactivation 10min->  10m  (IR: 600.0 SECOND)
  ddPCR QuantaSoft readout 30 min->  30m  (IR: 1800.0 SECOND)

Modules    : gelElectrophoresisDetection, dropletReadoutDetection
Manifests  : Cells, PBS, QuickExtract, BioMixRed, DMSO, ForwardPrimer_10uM,
             ReversePrimer_10uM, RNaseDNaseFreeH2O, AgaroseGel_1pct5to2pct,
             SYBR_Safe_Stain, TAE_Buffer_1X, DNALadder, ForwardPrimer_100uM,
             ReversePrimer_100uM, TargetProbe_FAM, ReferencePrimersProbe_HEX,
             ddPCR_Supermix_NoUTP, GenerationOil, FoilSealSheet

Abstractions:
  - Vortex steps (15 s) abstracted as heat at 25 C for 15 s (no standalone vortex op).
  - PBS wash/aspirate: mix then dispose(pbsWash); disposed variable never re-referenced.
  - PCR thermocycle loop: one representative cycle at 57 C (midpoint of 50-65 C); no loop.
  - ddPCR thermocycle loop: one representative cycle at 57 C; no loop construct.
  - Plate sealing (180 C, 5 s): heat(sealedPlate) after mix with FoilSealSheet.
  - Gel electrophoresis run: heat(gelRunReady) at 25 C for 40 m (voltage at ambient temp).
  - ddPCR DNA input: fresh second dispense/re-extraction block; avoids referencing disposed variable.
  - drain normalises to dispose in IR output per compiler behaviour.

CFG structure:
  BB1  main          -- entry: QuickExtract extraction; PCR master mix; thermocycling;
                        gel electrophoresis; gelElectrophoresisDetection
  BB2  bsbbif_2_t   -- gelSignal > 0:  dispose(gelRunReady)
  BB3  bsbbif_3_f   -- gelSignal <= 0: drain(gelRunReady)
  BB4  bsbbif_4_j   -- join: ddPCR probe prep; ddPCR master mix; droplet generation;
                        plate sealing; thermocycling; dropletReadoutDetection
  BB5  bsbbif_5_t   -- ddpcrSignal > 0:  dispose(sealedPlate)
  BB6  bsbbif_6_f   -- ddpcrSignal <= 0: drain(sealedPlate)
  BB7  bsbbif_7_j   -- terminal: dispose(ddpcrSignal); NOP; experiment ends

steps.name: Cell washing and QuickExtract DNA extraction

operations.action: Wash cells with 100 uL PBS per well; aspirate
Add 30 uL QuickExtract per well
Scrape well bottom with pipette tip to detach cells
Transfer cells to labelled PCR tubes
Vortex 15 s
Incubate at 65 C for 6 min
Vortex 15 s
Incubate at 98 C for 2 min
Store at -20 C

steps.notes: BioScript: vortex steps abstracted as heat at 25 C for 15 s (no standalone vortex op). PBS wash/aspirate modelled as mix then dispose(pbsWash).

operations.action: Resuspend IDT primers with H2O to 100 uM (e.g. 20 nmol -> add 200 uL H2O)
Dilute to 10 uM working stock (e.g. 20 uL + 180 uL H2O)
Store at -20 C

steps.name: PCR master mix preparation and reaction setup

operations.action: Prepare Master Mix for (number of reactions + 1) as extra
Add 1 uL DNA sample + 19 uL Master Mix per PCR tube
Load into Bio-Rad Thermal Cycler; select/edit PCR protocol

steps.name: PCR thermocycling

cycle_program.name: Annealing
cycle_program.notes: Annealing temperature should be 5-10 C lower than Tm of primers

steps.bioscript_abstraction: One representative cycle encoded at 57 C annealing (midpoint of 50-65 C range); 72 C extension for 60 s (1 min/kb); no loop construct in BioScript

steps.name: Gel electrophoresis and LI-COR imaging QC

gel_preparation.action: Prepare 1X TAE buffer (36 mL 50X TAE + diH2O to 1800 mL)
Prepare 1.5-2% agarose gel (e.g. 2 g agarose + 100 mL 1X TAE for 2%)
Heat in microwave until completely dissolved
Add 15 uL SYBR Safe DNA Gel Stain (per 150 mL gel)
Pour onto tray; remove bubbles; place comb (15 or 20 well)

gel_run.action: Place solidified gel in Bio-Rad Sub-Cell GT Cell; wells at negative (black) terminal
Fill with 1X TAE buffer until gel is submerged
Load ~12 uL DNA ladder (Quick-Load Purple 1 kb Plus) and PCR products
Run at 100-140 V (voltage depends on gel size); Black to Black, Red to Red
Run until bands are resolved (~40 min typical)

imaging.action: Clean LI-COR Odyssey M imager glass with EtOH and Kimwipe
Open LI-COR Acquisition Software; select Scan; Username: Clelland Lab; Imager: Odyssey M; Connect
Select Gel -> Connect; Draw Scan Area -> Next
Select 488 SYBR Safe; Save; Focus offset 2.00 mm; Scan
Clean imager glass again after use

steps.name: Gel extraction (for sequencing, optional)

operations.action: Run gel electrophoresis as above (50 uL reaction)
Excise desired gel band under UV light
Transfer gel slice to 1.5 mL tube
Add 0.6 mL Qiagen Buffer QG
Incubate at 50 C until gel completely dissolved; mix every 1-2 min
Add 100 uL 100% isopropanol; mix by inverting
Transfer to MinElute spin column (stored at 4 C); centrifuge 8000 rpm 1 min; discard filtrate; replace in collection tube
Repeat step 7 until all sample has passed through column
Add 650 uL Buffer PE; centrifuge 8000 rpm 1 min; discard filtrate; replace in collection tube
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm 1 min; discard filtrate and collection tube
Place column in new 1.5 mL tube
Add 35-50 uL Buffer EB to center of membrane
Incubate at 42 C for 3 min
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm 1 min
Repeat steps 12-14 to increase yield (reload DNA product from step 14)

steps.notes: Gel extraction not separately encoded in the primary BioScript file; it is a downstream offline step following a 50 uL PCR reaction.

operations.action: Thaw all components to room temperature
Vortex at full speed for 15 s between each mixing step
Combine primers and probe with H2O as above; mix thoroughly
Store at -20 C; protect FAM probe from light

steps.name: ddPCR master mix preparation and reaction setup

operations.action: Thaw all components to room temperature; vortex 15 s at full speed when mixing
Prepare Master Mix for (number of reactions + 1) as extra
Combine: 11 uL 2X Supermix + 1.1 uL 20X target + 1.1 uL 20X reference + H2O + DNA to 22 uL

steps.name: Droplet generation

operations.action: Insert DG8 Cartridge into cartridge holder
FIRST: load >20 uL sample into sample wells (all 8 wells must be loaded; empty wells: 50:50 Supermix + H2O; no bubbles)
THEN: load 70 uL generation oil into oil wells
Apply DG8 Gasket on cartridge
Load cartridge into QX200 Droplet Generator; START (~1 min)

steps.notes: Generation oil is single-use; can only be used within one day once opened. Transfer droplets within 5 min of generation.

steps.name: Droplet transfer and plate sealing

operations.action: Transfer 40 uL droplets to ddPCR 96-well plate; pipette SLOWLY (>7 s aspiration and dispensing)
Cover plate with foil seal sheet (red line facing up)
Seal in PX1 PCR Plate Sealer at 180 C for 5 s

steps.notes: Transfer must occur within 5 min of droplet generation. Slow pipetting prevents droplet shearing.

steps.name: ddPCR thermocycling
steps.instrument: Bio-Rad C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler with 96-Deep Well block
steps.constraint: Must be run within 40 min of plate sealing

cycle_program.name: Annealing/Extension
cycle_program.notes: Optimise annealing temperature using gradient when using primers/probe for first time

steps.bioscript_abstraction: One representative cycle encoded at 57 C (midpoint of 50-65 C range); 60 s annealing/extension; no loop construct in BioScript

operations.action: Let sealed plate equilibrate at room temperature for 1-2 min (storable at 4 C for up to 3 days before reading)
Place plate in Bio-Rad QX200 Droplet Reader
Open QuantaSoft; select well; configure: Experiment: CNV2; Supermix: ddPCR Supermix for Probes (no dUTP)
Target 1 (FAM): Ch 1 Unknown (enter name); Target 2 (HEX/VIC): Ch 2 Reference (e.g. RPP30)
Copy and paste configuration for every well used; save template; RUN
Data analysis: set threshold manually (pink line); separate positive droplets (blue/green) from negative (grey)

pcr_primers.avoid: more than 3 consecutive G or C repeats; complementary regions within or between primers
pcr_primers.melting_temperature_Tm_C: 50-65; primer pairs within 5 C of each other

ddpcr_probes.position: Between primer pair; no overlapping with primers
ddpcr_probes.composition: More Cs than Gs; no G at 5' end
ddpcr_probes.ordering: IDT PrimeTime qPCR Probes (5' FAM/ZEN/3' Iowa Black FQ)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: QuickExtract DNA extraction; PCR master mix prep; thermocycling; gel electrophoresis; gel QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: ddPCR probe prep; ddPCR master mix; droplet generation; plate sealing; thermocycling; droplet readout

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.description: dispose(ddpcrSignal); NOP; experiment ends

bioscript_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
bioscript_notes.duration_tokens: s (seconds) and m (minutes) only; h token not supported
abstractions: Vortex steps (15 s) abstracted as heat at 25 C for 15 s (no standalone vortex op in BioScript)
PBS wash/aspirate modelled as mix then dispose(pbsWash); disposed variable never re-referenced
PCR thermocycle loop: one representative cycle at 57 C annealing (midpoint); no loop construct
ddPCR thermocycle loop: one representative cycle at 57 C; no loop construct
Plate sealing at 180 C for 5 s modelled as heat(sealedPlate) after mix with FoilSealSheet
Gel electrophoresis run at 25 C for 40 m abstracts voltage application at ambient temperature
ddPCR DNA input: fresh second dispense/re-extraction block to avoid referencing disposed variable
drain normalises to dispose in IR output per compiler behaviour

description:
PROTOCOL DESCRIPTION
====================

Title        : Recovery of Phenotypically Sorted Cells Using Droplet-Digital Microfluidics
Source Link  : https://rscj.silverchair-cdn.com/rscj/content_public/journal/lc/25/17/10.1039_d5lc00415b/1/d5lc00415b.pdf
Paper DOI    : https://doi.org/10.1039/d5lc00415b
Journal      : Lab on a Chip, 2025, Vol. 25, pp. 4410-4421
Platform     : Droplet-Digital (D2) microfluidics (flow-focusing droplet-in-channel + DMF electrode array)


OVERVIEW
--------
This protocol describes a fully integrated Droplet-Digital (D2) microfluidic platform for the
isolation and recovery of rare single cells and beads from individually processed droplets. The
system combines high-throughput fluorescence-activated droplet sorting (FADS) with on-demand
digital microfluidic (DMF) control at the collection site, enabling direct, precise, and automated
transfer of sorted single-cell-containing droplets into conventional 96-well culture plates.

The core innovation is the elimination of tubing at the collection step, replacing it with an
open-access semicircular outlet where a 3 uL recovery buffer droplet is pre-generated and
parked on-chip. After each sorting event, the sorted ~1 nL droplet is merged with the recovery
buffer via DMF electrode actuation (140 Vrms, 15 kHz, 3 x 500 ms), and the merged ~4 uL
volume is manually pipetted directly into a well. This approach removes the two primary failure
modes of conventional tubing collection: (i) droplet trapping in the PDMS-tubing arc and
(ii) droplet coalescence/cross-talk between adjacent sorted droplets in contact.

The protocol is divided into three experimental sub-protocols encoded sequentially in the
BioScript file, sharing the same D2 device (except Protocol 3 Step 1, which uses a separate
co-encapsulation chip for hybridoma-target cell pairing):

  1. Fluorescent bead recovery benchmark (pooled and single recovery vs tubing method)
  2. Low-input rare GFP HEK293 single-cell sorting, recovery, and 7-day viability
  3. Rare specific-antibody-secreting hybridoma cell screening and recovery
     (antibody discovery application; off-chip 2 h co-incubation + on-chip re-injection sort)

Key performance results:
  - Single bead recovery:    ~87% (D2) vs ~5% (tubing); p < 0.0001
  - Pooled bead recovery:    ~93.5% (D2) vs ~78.5% (tubing); SD 5.29% vs 26.1%
  - GFP HEK293 recovery:     >80% across all ratios (1:400, 1:1000) and cell inputs (1e4, 1e5)
  - Post-sort viability:     ~90% over 7 days; cells exhibit spreading by day 1
  - Hybridoma 1:400 ratio:   ~88% recovery
  - Hybridoma 1:1000 ratio:  ~78% recovery
  - Overall improvement:     18-fold over conventional methods


DEVICE ARCHITECTURE
-------------------
Layer i   : Chromium electrodes patterned on 50x75 mm glass slides (Telic, Valencia, CA).
            S1811 positive photoresist; UV exposure 7 s at 38-50 mW/cm2; developed MF-321;
            etched CR-4 chromium etchant; stripped AZ-300T photoresist stripper.
            Chromium contact pads covered with Scotch 3M tape during spin coating.

Layer ii  : PDMS dielectric, ~7 um thick. 1:10 w/w curing agent:prepolymer (DOW Silicones)
            spin-coated at 4500 rpm for 90 s; baked 90 C for 1 h.

Layer iii : PDMS channel layer. Two-layer SU-8 2075 master on 100 mm Si wafer (each layer
            ~100 um; spin: 10 s at 500 rpm, 30 s at 2000 rpm, 10 s at 500 rpm). Master
            silanised with chlorotrimethylsilane vapour 45 min. PDMS (1:10 w/w) poured and
            cured at room temperature >= 48 h to prevent shrinkage. Bonded to substrate after
            15 s O2 plasma treatment; baked 60 C for 30 min. Channels treated with Aquapel
            1 min, dried, baked 85 C for 20 min.

Device sections:
  - Flow-focusing droplet generator (two inlets: oil I1, aqueous cells/beads I2)
  - Fiber-optic PMT detection zone (200 um core multimode fiber, 0.49 NA, Thorlabs)
  - DMF binary sorting junction (patterned electrodes beneath channel)
  - Six pairs of arrest electrodes in sorting channel (hold sorted droplet in transit)
  - Two 200x200 um merging electrodes at channel-collection interface
  - Semicircular open-access collection outlet (3 mm biopsy punch + razor-excised semicircle)
  - Recovery buffer inlet (500 uL gastight syringe, 1/32-inch PEEK tubing)
  - Withdraw/waste channel (2.5 mL gastight syringe, -0.15 uL/s default)

Inlets  : I1 (2.5 mL gastight, HFE7500 + 2% surfactant, Tygon 0.06-inch OD),
          I2 (1 mL BD plastic, cells/beads, Tygon 0.06-inch OD),
          I3 (500 uL gastight, recovery buffer, 1/32-inch PEEK)
Outlets : O1 (waste/withdraw, 2.5 mL gastight, 1/32-inch PEEK),
          O2 (semicircular open-access collection site, direct pipette access)

Electrode actuation: 140 Vrms, 15 kHz AC, via optocoupler switches controlled by Teensy 4.1
                     microcontroller + port expander + Keysight 33210A function generator +
                     Advanced Energy PZD700A amplifier.
Pump system        : Cetoni neMESYS low-pressure syringe pump (automated flow control).
Microscope         : Olympus IX73 inverted, vibration-dampened bench (Thorlabs).
Imaging (wells)    : EVOS M5000 imaging system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Software           : uflowcontrol (Python, open-source):
                     https://bitbucket.org/shihmicrolab/uflowcontrol
CAD files          : https://osf.io/jmxc6/


CELL LINES AND REAGENTS
-----------------------
Bead model   : FluoSpheres polystyrene microspheres, 10 um, blue-green fluorescent (430/465 nm),
               Thermo Fisher Scientific. Washed 3x PBS; diluted to 1e6 beads/mL; 16% OptiPrep added.

HEK293 cells : GFP-expressing and wild-type HEK293 (gift from Dr. Elena Kuzmin / Dr. Alisa
               Piekny lab, Concordia University). Cultured in DMEM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS
               + 1% penicillin/streptomycin; 37 C, 5% CO2; passage every 2 days at 80% confluency.
               Dissociated with trypsin (2 mL, 5 min, 37 C); quenched with 8 mL DMEM + 10% FBS;
               centrifuged 1000 rpm 5 min; resuspended in PBS for sorting.
               Spike ratios: 1:400 and 1:1000 (GFP:WT); inputs: 10,000 and 100,000 cells.
               80 uL OptiPrep added to 400 uL cell suspension (density matching).

Hybridoma    : Two lines provided by National Research Council Canada (NRC).
               Specific-Ab producer: secretes mAbs binding surface antigen of target cells;
                 stained calcein-AM red-orange (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
               Non-specific-Ab producer: secretes non-binding mAbs; unstained.
               Cultured in IMDM + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL + 1% P/S; passage every 3 days
               at 8x10^5 cells/mL in T-25 flasks. Used at mid-logarithmic, passage < 12.
               Spike ratios: 1:400 (0.25%) and 1:1000 (0.1%) specific:nonspecific.
               Sort buffer: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL (no antibiotics).
               11% w/v OptiPrep added; 3x prewash with neat IMDM to remove FBS.

Target cells : Antigen-overexpressing line (provided by NRC). Cultured DMEM + 10% FBS +
               G418 0.4 mg/mL; 37 C, 5% CO2. Dissociated with non-enzymatic cell
               dissociation solution (1x, pre-warmed 37 C) to preserve surface antigen.
               Resuspended at 3x10^6 cells/mL in IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL.
               Stained CellTrace Blue (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

Reagents     : HFE 7500 (3M Novec, M.G. Chemicals) + 2% 008-fluoro-surfactant (RAN Biotechnologies)
               OptiPrep iodixanol density gradient medium (Sigma-Aldrich)
               Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-mouse IgG (H+L), 2.5 ug/mL (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
               SYTOX Blue dead cell stain (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
               Recombinant mouse IL-6 carrier-free (Wisent Inc.)
               Aquapel (channel surface passivation)
               OptiPrep (Sigma-Aldrich); 16% for beads, 11% w/v for hybridoma/target cells

Recovery     : PBS (beads), DMEM (HEK293 cells), IMDM + 10% FBS + 1 ng/mL IL-6 (hybridoma)
buffers        3 uL on-chip; 100 uL pre-loaded in 96-well plate per well.
               Conditioned media (HEK293 post-sort, first 24 h): 30% spent eGFP HEK supernatant
               (0.22 um filtered) + 70% fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% P/S.


PROTOCOL STEPS
--------------

--- PROTOCOL 1: Fluorescent Bead Recovery ---

Step 1 | Device Priming and Baseline Flow
  Reagents  : HFE 7500 + 2% 008-fluoro-surfactant
  Operation : Inject oil at 0.15 uL/s via oil inlet; set waste syringe to -0.15 uL/s.
              All droplets routed to waste by default before any sorting event is triggered.
  Purpose   : Prime all channels; establish baseline flow direction.

Step 2 | Bead Suspension Preparation
  Reagents  : FluoSpheres 10 um blue-green, PBS, OptiPrep 16%
  Operation : Wash beads 3x PBS; dilute to 1e6 beads/mL; add 16% OptiPrep; load 1 mL BD syringe.
  Purpose   : OptiPrep prevents bead clumping and sedimentation during chip operation.

Step 3 | Bead Encapsulation in ~1 nL Droplets
  Flow rates : Oil 0.15 uL/s; aqueous bead phase 0.05 uL/s
  Droplet    : ~1 nL, monodisperse, ~50 Hz generation rate
  Sorting    : PMT threshold 7e3 to 2e4 photon counts; selects single-bead droplets.
               Below lower bound = empty droplet; above upper bound = multi-bead droplet.

Step 4 | PMT Detection, Sorting, and Recovery (Pooled or Single)
  Excitation : 470 nm (X-Cite XLED1); emission ~520 nm; detected by Hamamatsu H11890 PMT.
  Trigger    : Fluorescence peak within threshold window actuates sorting electrode.
  Recovery   : 3 uL PBS buffer generated at 1 uL/s; parked at semicircular outlet.
               7 s delay post-sort; 3x electrode actuation (140 Vrms, 15 kHz, 500 ms each).
               Merged ~4 uL transferred via P20 pipette (5 uL) to 96-well plate well
               pre-loaded with 100 uL PBS. Transfer time: ~10 s per well.
  Pooled     : 50 sorted droplets -> 1 well; then limiting dilution (1 bead/well).
  Single     : 1 sorted droplet -> 1 well (50 individual transfer operations).

  Results (pooled):  D2 ~93.5% vs tubing ~78.5%; D2 SD 5.29% vs tubing SD 26.1%.
  Results (single):  D2 ~87% vs tubing ~5%; p < 0.0001 (unpaired t-test).


--- PROTOCOL 2: Low-Input Rare GFP HEK293 Cell Recovery ---

Step 5 | Rare GFP Cell Mixture Preparation
  Cell lines : GFP-expressing HEK293 and WT HEK293; both at 1e6 cells/mL.
  Ratios     : 1:400 and 1:1000 (GFP:WT); total inputs 10,000 and 100,000 cells.
  Buffer     : PBS (Ca2+/Mg2+ free) + 80 uL OptiPrep per 400 uL suspension; gentle vortex.
  Syringe    : 480 uL loaded into 1 mL BD plastic syringe.

Step 6 | GFP Cell Encapsulation and Sorting
  Sorting threshold : 1e3 to 2.5e3 photon counts (lower than bead threshold; single GFP cell
                      fluorescence is weaker than bead signal).
  Detection         : singleCellGFPDetection module; 10 s detection window per droplet.
  Recovery          : Same D2 workflow as Step 4 but with 3 uL DMEM recovery buffer.
                      Well plate pre-loaded: 100 uL DMEM per well.

Step 7 | Post-Sort Conditioned Media Culture (First 24 h)
  Media      : 150 uL conditioned media per well (30% spent eGFP HEK supernatant,
               0.22 um filtered, + 70% fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% P/S).
  Incubation : 24 h at 37 C, 5% CO2 (= 1440 min; IR: 86400 s).
  Purpose    : Conditioned media supports single-cell survival in the immediate post-sort period.

Step 8 | Viability Monitoring (SYTOX Blue, Days 1-7)
  Stain      : SYTOX Blue dead cell stain; 10 wells per time point per manufacturer protocol.
  Imaging    : EVOS M5000; every 24 h.
  Viability  : (non-blue wells) / (total stained wells) x 100.
  Detection  : viabilityDetection module; 60 s read.

Step 9 | 7-Day Clonal Expansion
  Media      : 50 uL fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% P/S added every 48 h.
  Duration   : 6 remaining days after 24 h conditioned media phase = 8640 min (IR: 518400 s).
  Imaging    : EVOS M5000 bright-field + GFP fluorescence; every 24 h.
  Incubation : 37 C, 5% CO2.

  Results: >80% recovery across all ratios and cell inputs. ~90% viability over 7 days.
           Cells exhibit spreading by day 1 (positive viability indicator).
           Example: 1:1000 ratio, 6 GFP cells sorted and recovered in ~1 h operation.


--- PROTOCOL 3: Rare Antibody-Secreting Hybridoma Screening and Recovery ---

Step 10 | Hybridoma and Target Cell Preparation
  Hybridoma  : Specific (calcein-AM red, 1e6 cells/mL) + nonspecific (unstained) mixed at
               1:400 or 1:1000 in IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL + 11% OptiPrep.
  Target     : 3e6 cells/mL in IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL +
               Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse IgG 2.5 ug/mL + 11% OptiPrep. Stained CellTrace Blue.
  Prewash    : Both cell types washed 3x neat IMDM to remove FBS before experiment.
  Staining   : Calcein-AM red-orange (hybridoma); CellTrace Blue (target) per manufacturer protocol.

Step 11 | Co-Encapsulation (Separate Co-Encapsulation Chip)
  Chip       : Flow-focusing co-encapsulation chip (two cell inlets).
  Flow rates : Hybridoma 0.3 uL/s; target + secondary Ab 0.3 uL/s; oil 0.8 uL/s;
               withdrawal syringe (BD 1 mL plastic) at 1.4 uL/s.
  Occupancy  : 5-10% double-cell droplets (hybridoma + target) by Poisson statistics.
  Oil        : HFE 7500 + 2% 008-fluoro-surfactant (RAN Biotechnologies).

Step 12 | Off-Chip Droplet Incubation
  Duration   : 2 h at 37 C, 5% CO2 (= 120 min; IR: 7200 s).
  Collection : Withdrawal syringe (BD 1 mL plastic) incubated in mammalian cell incubator.
  Mechanism  : Specific mAbs secreted by hybridoma cells bind surface antigen of co-encapsulated
               target cells. Pre-added Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibodies bind primary mAbs,
               generating sharp high-intensity green fluorescence (>18,000 counts) uniquely in
               specific-Ab + target cell doublet droplets.
  Signal logic:
    Specific-Ab producer + target cell  : >18,000 photon counts (Alexa Fluor 488 surface-bound)
    Non-specific hybridoma only          : medium fluorescence (free secondary Ab baseline)
    Target cell only or empty            : background fluorescence

Step 13 | Re-Injection into D2 Sorting Chip
  Flow rates : Droplet re-injection 0.02 uL/s; spacing oil 0.15 uL/s; waste -0.12 uL/s.
               Slower re-injection rate maintains droplet integrity post-off-chip incubation.
  Throughput : ~50 Hz sorting; ~1 nL monodisperse droplets.

Step 14 | Antibody-Binding Sort and Single-Pair Recovery
  Detection  : antibodyBindingDetection module; 488 nm excitation; 520 nm emission.
               Sorting threshold: 1.8e4 to 3e4 photon counts (green channel).
  Recovery   : 3 uL IMDM + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL recovery buffer generated at 1 uL/s.
               7-9 s delay post-sort; 3x electrode actuation (140 Vrms, 15 kHz, 500 ms each).
               Merged contents pipetted (P20, 5 uL) to 96-well plate pre-loaded with 100 uL
               IMDM + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL + 1% P/S. Plate to incubator immediately.
  Imaging    : EVOS M5000; confirm specific-Ab hybridoma by:
               calcein-AM red (hybridoma) + CellTrace Blue (target) + Alexa Fluor 488 green (bound Ab).

  Results: 1:400 ratio ~88% recovery; 1:1000 ratio ~78% recovery.
           Compared to ~30% conventional droplet recovery (Clausell-Tormos et al.).


BIOSCRIPT COMPILER NOTES
-------------------------
BioScript file : deng2025_d2_droplet_digital_recovery_v2.bs
Compiler       : lilott8/BioScript (ANTLR4-based)
IR output      : deng2025_d2_droplet_digital_recovery.ir
DAG output     : deng2025_d2_droplet_digital_recovery_main_dag.dot
Basic blocks   : 13 (BB1-BB13); 3 if/else sort gates; 16 CFG edges
Duration units : All durations converted to minutes (m) for compiler compatibility
                 (BioScript supports s and m only; h token not supported)
                 1440m  -> 24 h conditioned media incubation   (IR: 86400.0 SECOND)
                 8640m  -> 6-day clonal expansion remainder     (IR: 518400.0 SECOND)
                 120m   -> 2 h off-chip droplet incubation     (IR: 7200.0 SECOND)
                 1800m  -> 30 min calcein-AM staining          (IR: 1800.0 SECOND -- note: 30m)
                 1200m  -> 20 min CellTrace Blue staining      (IR: 1200.0 SECOND -- note: 20m)
Modules        : fluorescenceActivatedDropletSorting, singleBeadDetection,
                 singleCellGFPDetection, antibodyBindingDetection, viabilityDetection
Manifests      : PBS, DMEM_Complete, IMDM_Complete, IMDM_NoPhenolRed, HFE7500_Surfactant,
                 OptiPrep, GFP_HEK293_Cells, WT_HEK293_Cells, FluoroSpheres_10um,
                 CalceinAM_RedOrange, CellTrace_Blue, AlexaFluor488_AntiMouse,
                 HybridomaSpecific_Cells, HybridomaNonSpecific_Cells, TargetCells,
                 SYTOX_Blue, ConditionedMedia_HEK, RecoveryBuffer_PBS,
                 RecoveryBuffer_DMEM, RecoveryBuffer_IMDM, IL6_Supplement

Key compiler observations (v2, confirmed clean):
  - drain normalised to dispose in IR -- expected behaviour; confirmed by reference files
  - alexaFluor4881[0] in IR is variable 'alexaFluor488' + instance suffix '1'; not stale
    (digits in variable name cause regex false positive; raw IR confirms single instance)
  - All variable instance indices are 1 throughout IR; no phantom/stale variables
  - undefined-before-use flags on branch-target blocks are text-order artifacts;
    IR is not in execution order; all variables defined in 'main' before any branch executes
  - v1 bug fixed in v2: mergedCellDrop was disposed inside BB5 pass branch but referenced
    again in BB7; replaced with fresh wellEnvironment = dispense DMEM_Complete dispense
  - BioScript has no loop construct; one representative sort cycle per protocol encoded,
    consistent with reference files (samlali_hybrid_microfluidics_isoclone.bs,
    moazami_world_to_chip_dmf.bs)
  - Biological scope: all three experimental protocols (bead, HEK293, hybridoma) encoded
    in a single sequential .bs file sharing one CFG entry point (main)

CFG edge map:
  BB1  -> BB2  (beadSignal > 0: pass)
  BB1  -> BB3  (beadSignal <= 0: fail)
  BB2  -> BB4  (join)
  BB3  -> BB4  (join)
  BB4  -> BB5  (cellSignal > 0: pass)
  BB4  -> BB6  (cellSignal <= 0: fail)
  BB5  -> BB7  (join)
  BB6  -> BB7  (join)
  BB7  -> BB8  (viabilitySignal > 0: pass)
  BB7  -> BB9  (viabilitySignal <= 0: fail)
  BB8  -> BB10 (join)
  BB9  -> BB10 (join)
  BB10 -> BB11 (abSignal > 0: pass)
  BB10 -> BB12 (abSignal <= 0: fail)
  BB11 -> BB13 (terminal join)
  BB12 -> BB13 (terminal join)

HEK293 GFP-expressing (gift from Dr. Elena Kuzmin / Dr. Alisa Piekny lab)

protocol.objective: Integrated droplet-digital (D2) microfluidic platform for isolation and recovery of rare single cells and beads from processed droplets; applied to fluorescent bead recovery, low-input rare GFP HEK293 cell sorting, and rare specific-antibody-secreting hybridoma cell screening and recovery for antibody discovery

key_results.cell_recovery_D2_pct: >80 across all ratios and cell inputs

device.name: Droplet-Digital (D2) Microfluidic Device
layers: Layer i: Chromium electrodes patterned on 50x75 mm glass slides (Telic, Valencia, CA); S1811 positive resist; UV exposure 7 s at 38-50 mW/cm2; developed MF-321; etched CR-4; stripped AZ-300T
Layer ii: PDMS dielectric, ~7 um thick; 1:10 w/w curing agent:prepolymer spin-coated at 4500 rpm for 90 s; baked 90 C for 1 h
Layer iii: PDMS channel layer; SU-8 2075 on 100 mm Si wafer; two-layer master (100 um each); soft lithography; room-temperature cure >= 48 h to prevent shrinkage
channel_sections: Six pairs of arrest electrodes in sorting channel
Semicircular open-access collection outlet (3 mm biopsy punch, razor-excised semicircle)

electrodes.sorter_type: DMF binary sorter with patterned electrodes beneath channel
electrodes.advantage_over_DEP: DEP systems require 200-1200 V; D2 uses <140 Vrms, minimising electric-field-induced cell damage

inlets.oil_inlet: 2.5 mL gastight syringe, HFE7500 + 2% 008-fluoro-surfactant, Tygon 0.06-inch OD tubing
inlets.aqueous_inlet: 1 mL BD plastic syringe, cells/beads, Tygon 0.06-inch OD tubing
inlets.recovery_buffer_inlet: 500 uL gastight syringe, 1/32-inch OD PEEK tubing
inlets.withdrawal_waste: 2.5 mL gastight syringe, 1/32-inch OD PEEK tubing, set to -0.15 uL/s

outlet.access: Direct manual pipetting from collection channel to well plate

detection.fiber: 200 um core, 0.49 NA multimode optical fiber (Thorlabs)

device.surface_treatment: Aquapel, 1 min; dried; baked 85 C for 20 min

control_system.switches: Stacked optocoupler switch board + port expander
control_system.pump: Cetoni neMESYS low-pressure syringe pump system

reagents.surfactant: 008-fluoro-surfactant 5% wt in HFE7500 (RAN Biotechnologies), used at 2% w/v
reagents.density_gradient: OptiPrep iodixanol density gradient medium (Sigma-Aldrich); 16% for beads, 11% w/v for hybridoma/target cells, 80 uL added to 400 uL cell suspension for HEK experiments

bead_model.preparation: Washed 3x PBS; diluted to 1e6 beads/mL; 16% OptiPrep added

cell_media.hybridoma_culture: IMDM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS + mouse IL-6 1 ng/mL + 1% penicillin/streptomycin
cell_media.hybridoma_sort: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + mouse IL-6 1 ng/mL (no antibiotics)
cell_media.target_cell_sort: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody 2.5 ug/mL (no antibiotics)
cell_media.conditioned_media_HEK: 30% spent eGFP HEK supernatant (0.22 um filtered) + 70% fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% P/S; used first 24 h post-sort

AlexaFluor488_AntiMouse.labels: secondary antibody for specific mAb binding detection

SYTOX_Blue.labels: dead cells (blue stain); used for post-sort viability assay

recovery_buffers.beads: PBS (100 uL pre-loaded per well + 3 uL on-chip recovery buffer)
recovery_buffers.HEK293: DMEM (100 uL pre-loaded per well + 3 uL on-chip recovery buffer)
recovery_buffers.hybridoma: IMDM + 10% FBS + 1 ng/mL IL-6 + 1% P/S (100 uL pre-loaded + 3 uL on-chip recovery buffer)

protocols.name: Fluorescent bead recovery (pooled and single)
protocols.purpose: Benchmark D2 recovery against conventional tubing method; establish baseline recovery rate and reproducibility for bead model

steps.name: Device priming and baseline flow setup
steps.notes: Oil injected first to prime all channels. Waste syringe set to -0.15 uL/s so all droplets default to waste channel before sorting is triggered.

steps.name: Bead suspension preparation
steps.notes: Beads washed 3x PBS; OptiPrep prevents clumping/sedimentation during chip operation.

steps.name: Bead encapsulation in ~1 nL droplets
steps.operation: flow-focusing encapsulation (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Poisson-based encapsulation. Sorting threshold 7e3-2e4 photon counts selects single-bead droplets.

steps.name: Fiber-optic PMT detection and FADS sorting
steps.notes: Peaks above lower bound and below upper bound (multi-bead exclusion) trigger electrode actuation at sorting junction.

pass.action: generate recovery buffer; merge; pipette to well

steps.name: On-demand droplet collection and recovery
steps.operation: dispense recovery buffer + DMF electrode merge + manual pipette
steps.notes: Sorted 1 nL droplet travels to collection outlet after 7 s delay (arrested by 6 electrode pairs). 3x electrode actuation merges droplet with 3 uL PBS buffer. P20 pipette (5 uL) transfers merged contents to individual well.

pooled_recovery.significance: ns (no significant difference between D2 and tubing at each n)
pooled_recovery.notes: D2 fivefold reduction in SD at 50 beads vs tubing. Tubing arc traps droplets; HFE oil heavier than aqueous phase causes droplets to remain at top of tubing.

single_recovery.notes: Single recovery = 1 droplet per well. Tubing fails at single recovery because insufficient flow rate to displace individual droplets through arc; droplets trapped at PDMS-tubing interface (wall thickness > droplet diameter <100 um).

protocols.name: Low-input rare single GFP HEK293 cell recovery and viability
protocols.purpose: Demonstrate D2 recovery of rare target cells at biologically relevant low ratios; validate post-sort viability and proliferation over 7 days

steps.name: Cell culture and preparation
steps.culture_conditions: DMEM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS + 1% P/S; 37 C, 5% CO2; passage every 2 days at 80% confluency
steps.trypsinization: 2 mL trypsin, 5 min 37 C; quench 8 mL DMEM + 10% FBS; centrifuge 1000 rpm 5 min; resuspend PBS
steps.optiprep_addition: 80 uL OptiPrep added to 400 uL cell suspension; vortex gently
steps.notes: Low-volume inputs mimic rare cell scenarios. 1:1000 ratio models 0.1% target frequency, comparable to antigen-specific B cell rarity.

pass.action: generate DMEM recovery buffer; merge; pipette to well

steps.name: Single cell recovery into 96-well plate
steps.operation: dispense recovery buffer + DMF electrode merge + manual pipette
steps.notes: One cell per well. Plate transferred to incubator immediately after experiment.

steps.name: Post-sort cell culture: conditioned media phase
steps.conditioned_media_composition: 30% spent eGFP HEK supernatant (0.22 um filtered) + 70% fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% P/S
steps.notes: Conditioned media supports single-cell survival in first 24 h post-sort.

steps.name: 7-day clonal expansion
steps.imaging: EVOS M5000; bright-field and GFP fluorescence every 24 h
steps.notes: Cells exhibit spreading by day 1 (positive viability indicator). GFP fluorescence confirms identity. Proliferation confirmed over 7 days.

results.recovery_rate_D2_pct: >80 for all conditions (1e4 and 1e5 cells; 1:400 and 1:1000 ratios)
results.proliferation: Confirmed over 7 days with spreading at day 1

protocols.name: Rare specific-antibody-secreting hybridoma cell screening and recovery
protocols.purpose: Antibody discovery application: sort and recover specific-mAb-secreting hybridoma cells co-encapsulated with target antigen-expressing cells at rare biological ratios

steps.name: Hybridoma cell mixture preparation

cell_lines.specific_Ab_producer: Hybridoma secreting mAbs that bind surface antigen of target cells; stained with calcein-AM red-orange

steps.rationale: Models natural frequency of antigen-specific B cells (0.1-2% of isolated B cells)
steps.buffer: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + 1 ng/mL IL-6 (no antibiotics)
steps.prewash: 3x with neat IMDM to remove FBS before experiment
steps.notes: Passage < 12; mid-logarithmic growth phase.

steps.name: Target cell preparation
steps.dissociation: Non-enzymatic cell dissociation solution (1x, pre-warmed 37 C) to preserve surface antigen expression
steps.buffer: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + 1 ng/mL IL-6
steps.secondary_antibody: Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-mouse IgG (H+L), 2.5 ug/mL
steps.notes: Secondary antibody pre-added to target cell suspension; accumulates on cell surface only if specific primary mAb is present after co-incubation.

steps.name: Co-encapsulation (separate co-encapsulation chip)
steps.operation: flow-focusing co-encapsulation (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Double-cell droplets contain one hybridoma cell + one target cell. Poisson occupancy.

steps.name: Off-chip droplet incubation
steps.collection: Withdrawal syringe (BD 1 mL plastic) collects droplets
steps.mechanism: Specific mAbs secreted by hybridoma cells bind to target cell surface antigen. Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibodies bind primary mAbs, generating high-intensity green fluorescence (>18,000 counts) exclusively in specific-Ab + target cell doublet droplets.

steps.name: Re-injection into D2 sorting chip and antibody-binding sort

pass.action: generate IMDM recovery buffer; merge; pipette to well

steps.name: Single hybridoma-target cell pair recovery into 96-well plate
steps.operation: dispense recovery buffer + DMF electrode merge + manual pipette
steps.verification: Specific-Ab hybridoma confirmed by calcein-AM red co-localisation; target cell by CellTrace Blue; binding by Alexa Fluor 488 green
steps.notes: Well plate moved to incubator immediately post-experiment.

results.advantage: On-demand selective collection based on phenotypic fluorescence readout significantly reduces false positives and minimises stochastic sample loss vs passive flow valve mechanisms (e.g. Cyto-Mine)

compiler_notes: drain normalised to dispose in IR -- expected compiler behaviour, confirmed by reference files
alexaFluor4881[0] in IR is variable alexaFluor488 + instance suffix 1 -- not a stale reference (regex parsing artifact)
All variable instances are 1 throughout IR -- no stale or phantom variables
undefined-before-use flags on beadDroplets/beadSignal in branch blocks are text-order artifacts; IR is not in execution order; both variables are defined in main before any branch target executes
