description:
PROTOCOL DESCRIPTION
====================

Title        : A Non-Optical Multiplexed PCR Diagnostic Platform for Serotype-Specific Detection of Dengue Virus
Source Link  : https://academicweb.nd.edu/~changlab/documents/Yin2020.pdf
Paper DOI    : https://doi.org/10.1016/j.snb.2020.127854
Journal      : Sensors & Actuators B: Chemical, 2020, Vol. 310, Article 127854
Platform     : Integrated on-chip RT-PCR + ion-exchange membrane (IEM) sensor array on polycarbonate microfluidic chip


OVERVIEW
--------
This protocol describes a non-optical, multiplexed, point-of-care (POC) microfluidic platform for
simultaneous serotype-specific detection of all four dengue virus (DENV) serotypes from 1 mL of
human blood plasma in a single on-chip PCR reactor. The platform integrates three functional units:

  1. Off-chip RNA extraction using a chitosan-modified Fusion 5 filter paper dip-and-rinse technique
  2. On-chip multiplex RT-PCR amplification of all four DENV serotypes in a single 25 uL reactor
  3. Ion-exchange membrane (IEM) sensor array detection via current-voltage curve (CVC) measurement

By replacing optical (fluorescence/RT-qPCR) readout with ion-selective nanomembrane sensors, the
platform eliminates spectral overlap constraints and can be scaled to detect arbitrarily large numbers
of targets from a single sample. The IEM sensor's ion-depletion action increases the Debye length in
the detection zone (>30 nm), making it insensitive to pH variation, ionic strength, duplex conformation,
and non-specific amplification products -- the key failure modes of optical and electrochemical sensors.

Total assay time: ~90 min. Limit of detection: 100 copies/mL RNA in spiked human plasma (3x better
than any prior PCR-based DENV technology, Table 1).


DEVICE ARCHITECTURE
-------------------
Chip material  : Polycarbonate thermosoftening plastic (3 layers, each 0.3 mm thick)
Chip dimensions: 10 x 4 x 0.1 cm3 (l/w/t)
Fabrication    : Graphtec Pro FC 7000MK2-60 cutting plotter; thermal/pressure bonding

Sections:
  - On-chip PCR chip       : 25 uL reaction chamber; thermocouple plate for thermal cycling
  - AEM sensing chip       : Anion-exchange nanomembrane (AME) sensor array with input/output channels;
                             4 isolated reservoirs, one per DENV serotype sensor

AEM sensor composition:
  Material     : Polystyrene-divinylbenzene with strong basic quaternary ammonium groups;
                 polyethylene binder; polyamide/polyester textile fiber support (Mega a.s., Czech Republic)
  Dimensions   : 0.9 x 0.3 x 0.3 mm3 (l/w/t) per sensor piece; 1 or 4 pieces per sensor
  Functionalization: Serotype-specific oligoprobe attached via EDC coupling on the depletion side

Electrodes:
  Reference    : 2x Ag-AgCl (measure potential across nanomembrane sensor)
  Current      : 2x Platinum (apply current load 0-40 uA at 1 uA/s step rate)
  Potentiostat : Gamry 500 (Gamry Instruments, Warminster, PA); Gamry Framework software

Fluidics box:
  Dimensions   : 102 x 240 x 305 mm3 (l/w/t); contains fluidic pump and thermocouple heater


PATHOGENS AND SAMPLES
---------------------
- DENV-1  : WP-74 strain
- DENV-2  : OBS8041 strain
- DENV-3  : CH53489 strain
- DENV-4  : H241 strain
  (All DENV strains from Naval Medical Research Center, NMRC)
- ZIKV    : PRVABC59 strain (Emory University; used as non-specific negative control)
- Matrix  : Human blood plasma (ZenBio Inc., NC, USA); 1 mL per assay


PROTOCOL STEPS
--------------

Step 1 | TRIzol-Chloroform Lysis and Phase Separation
  Reagents     : HumanPlasma_DENV_RNA (1 mL), TRIzol_Reagent, Chloroform (0.2 mL)
  Operation    : Vortex with TRIzol 30 s; add chloroform, mix 60 s; centrifuge to separate phases
  Temperature  : 25 C (room temperature phase separation; 120 s)
  Output       : Aqueous supernatant containing DENV RNA (also contains PCR inhibitor
                 Guanidinium thiocyanate from TRIzol)
  BioScript    : Abstracted as mix(TRIzol, 30s) -> mix(Chloroform, 60s) -> heat(25C, 120s)
  Notes        : DENV RNA in plasma is predominantly encapsulated within virions; lysis step
                 is required to release internal RNA. TRIzol-chloroform emulsion aqueous phase
                 collected as supernatant for downstream filter paper extraction.

Step 2 | Chitosan Filter Paper Dip-and-Rinse RNA Extraction
  Reagents     : ChitosanFilterDisc (1 mm diameter), SDS_Wash (1% SDS), DI_Water
  Filter prep  : 5 cm Fusion 5 paper (Whatman); O2 plasma 2 min; overnight chitosan soak
                 (0.05% w/v in 0.1% acetic acid, pH 6.0); wash 3x DI water; vacuum dry;
                 cut to 1 mm discs; stored at room temperature
  Immersion    : Disc immersed in aqueous supernatant; incubate 5 min
  Wash         : 1% SDS (30 s) then DI water (30 s) to remove PCR inhibitors
  Mechanism    : Positively charged chitosan matrix electrostatically captures negatively
                 charged RNA molecules via physical entanglement and electrostatic adsorption
  Recovery     : Down to 50 copies/mL RNA; ~98% extraction efficiency (Liu et al. 2017)
  Duration     : ~10 min total (5 min incubation + 5 min wash)
  BioScript    : mix(disc, 5m) -> mix(SDS, 30s) -> mix(DI water, 30s)
  Notes        : No elution step; filter disc introduced directly into PCR mixture.
                 Chitosan also removes Guanidinium thiocyanate PCR inhibitor from TRIzol phase.

Step 3 | Multiplex RT-PCR Master Mix Assembly and On-Chip Loading
  Reagents     : RT_PCR_MasterMix (12.5 uL), DENV1_Primers (0.5 uL fwd+rev),
                 DENV2_Primers (0.25 uL fwd+rev), DENV3_Primers (0.5 uL fwd+rev),
                 DENV4_Primers (0.25 uL fwd+rev), iScript_RT (0.5 uL), NucleaseFree_H2O (5.0 uL)
  Total volume : 20 uL PCR reaction mixture
  Kit          : iTaq Universal SYBR Green One-Step Kit (Bio-Rad, cat. no. 1725150)
  Primer ref   : Santiago et al. 2013 (CDC real-time RT-PCR assay for DENV 1-4)
  Primer source: Integrated DNA Technologies, Inc.
  Loading      : RNA-loaded filter disc added to assembled PCR mixture; loaded into chip;
                 inlets and outlets sealed; placed on thermocouple plate
  BioScript    : Sequential mix of all primer sets into master mix; mix(rxn_mix, washed_disc, 10s)
  Notes        : Four primer sets in one 25 uL reactor. Spurious bands (primer dimers, mispriming)
                 visible by gel electrophoresis with four primer sets; these are non-issues for
                 IEM sensor detection because probe hybridisation is serotype-specific.

Step 4 | Reverse Transcription (50 C, 30 min)
  Operation    : heat
  Temperature  : 50 C
  Duration     : 1800 s (30 min)
  Purpose      : DENV RNA reverse transcribed to cDNA by iScript reverse transcriptase

Step 5 | RT Inactivation and Initial Denaturation (95 C, 2 min)
  Operation    : heat
  Temperature  : 95 C
  Duration     : 120 s (2 min)
  Purpose      : Inactivates reverse transcriptase; denatures RNA:cDNA hybrid; activates polymerase

Step 6 | PCR Cycling - Denaturation Phase (95 C, 35 cycles x 15 s)
  Operation    : heat
  Temperature  : 95 C
  Duration     : 525 s (35 cycles x 15 s; collapsed to single heat statement)
  BioScript    : No loop construct in lilott8/BioScript; 35 x 15 s = 525 s total

Step 7 | PCR Cycling - Annealing and Extension Phase (55 C, 35 cycles x 60 s)
  Operation    : heat
  Temperature  : 55 C
  Duration     : 2100 s (35 cycles x 60 s; collapsed to single heat statement)
  Amplicons    : DENV-1: 110 bp | DENV-2: 98 bp | DENV-3: 78 bp | DENV-4: 83 bp
  BioScript    : 35 x 60 s = 2100 s total

Step 8 | Post-PCR ssDNA Generation (95 C, 5 min)
  Operation    : heat
  Temperature  : 95 C
  Duration     : 300 s (5 min)
  Purpose      : Denatures dsDNA amplicons to ssDNA in same PCR chamber for IEM hybridisation
  Paper ref    : Section 2.4: "heated at 95 C for 5 min in the same chamber to get ssDNA
                 for the downstream detection"

Step 9 | IEM Sensor 1 - DENV-1 Detection
  Reagents     : ssdna_amplicons, DENV1_Oligoprobe_AEM, PBS_4x, PBS_0_1x
  Hybridisation: Incubate ssDNA amplicons on AEM sensor surface for 15 min
  Wash         : 4x PBS, 5 min (hydrodynamic shear removes non-specifically bound targets)
  Measurement  : Transfer to 0.1x PBS; CVC acquired 0-40 uA at 1 uA/s via Gamry 500
  Detection    : denv1Detection module; 30 s
  Expected CVC shift (target)   : ~0.55 V
  Detection cutoff              : 0.2 V (established from Fig. 4 reproducibility data)
  Branch       : denv1Signal > 0  -> dispose (BB2, DENV-1 detected)
                 denv1Signal <= 0 -> drain   (BB3, not detected)

Step 10 | IEM Sensor 2 - DENV-2 Detection
  Reagents     : ssdna_amplicons, DENV2_Oligoprobe_AEM, PBS_4x, PBS_0_1x
  Protocol     : Identical to Step 9
  Expected CVC shift (target)   : ~0.61 V
  Detection cutoff              : 0.2 V
  Branch       : denv2Signal > 0  -> dispose (BB5, DENV-2 detected)
                 denv2Signal <= 0 -> drain   (BB6, not detected)

Step 11 | IEM Sensor 3 - DENV-3 Detection
  Reagents     : ssdna_amplicons, DENV3_Oligoprobe_AEM, PBS_4x, PBS_0_1x
  Protocol     : Identical to Step 9
  Expected CVC shift (target)   : ~0.67 V
  Detection cutoff              : 0.2 V
  Branch       : denv3Signal > 0  -> dispose (BB8, DENV-3 detected)
                 denv3Signal <= 0 -> drain   (BB9, not detected)

Step 12 | IEM Sensor 4 - DENV-4 Detection
  Reagents     : ssdna_amplicons, DENV4_Oligoprobe_AEM, PBS_4x, PBS_0_1x
  Protocol     : Identical to Step 9
  Expected CVC shift (target)   : ~0.53 V
  Detection cutoff              : 0.2 V
  Branch       : denv4Signal > 0  -> dispose (BB11, DENV-4 detected)
                 denv4Signal <= 0 -> drain   (BB12, not detected)


IEM SENSOR PHYSICS
------------------
Mechanism    : External concentration polarization across anion-exchange membrane (AEM)
               under applied electric field. Asymmetric ion migration creates a depletion
               zone (ion-free, high resistance) and enrichment zone on opposite sides.
Depletion zone: Forms at second critical voltage; Debye length >30 nm (vs ~1 nm at normal
               PCR buffer ionic strength). This large Debye length makes CVC shift insensitive
               to duplex conformation, pairing sequence location, and dangling tail lengths.
Limiting current: Differential resistance in depletion regime orders of magnitude higher than
               membrane resistance alone. Small number of charged targets produces large CVC shift.
Overlimiting : Electroconvective instability (vortices) above limiting voltage shears off
               non-specifically bound targets; further enhances selectivity.
Detection    : Probe-functionalized AEM depletion side. Hybridised target-probe duplexes
               suppress depletion action and shift CVC in overlimiting regime by several volts.
               Shift is 10-100x larger than electrochemical sensor signals.
Selectivity  : Hydrodynamic shear (4x PBS wash + flow) + electroconvective vortices remove
               non-specific PCR products, primer dimers, and cross-reactive ZIKV/DENV serotypes.


PERFORMANCE SUMMARY
-------------------
Total assay time              : ~90 min
Limit of detection            : 100 copies/mL (DENV RNA in spiked human plasma)
Sample volume                 : 1 mL human blood plasma
Serotypes detected            : 4 (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, DENV-4) simultaneously
Detection cutoff (CVC shift)  : >0.2 V (target group average ~0.4 V; no overlap with control)
Validated against             : ZIKV, all three non-target DENV serotypes, primer dimers,
                                 misprimed non-target products, heterogeneous plasma matrix

Comparison (Table 1, paper):
  PCR                         : 350 copies/mL
  CDC RT-PCR                  : 1 x 10^3 GCE/mL
  ELISA                       : 600 copies/mL
  Optical Surface Plasmon Res.: 2 x 10^4 particles/mL
  FCCS                        : 9 x 10^9 particles/mL
  Nanoporous Alumina Membrane : 16 x 10^8 particles/mL
  IEM Sensor (this work)      : 100 copies/mL  <-- 3x better than nearest PCR-based method


BIOSCRIPT COMPILER NOTES
-------------------------
BioScript file : yin2020_denv_multiplexed_pcr.bs
Compiler       : lilott8/BioScript (ANTLR4-based)
IR output      : 13 basic blocks (BB1-BB13), 4 if/else gates, 16 CFG edges
DAG            : yin2020_denv_multiplexed_pcr_main_dag.dot
Duration units : All durations in seconds (s) or minutes (m); hours not supported
                 RT-PCR cycling collapsed: 35 x 15 s denaturation -> 525 s
                                           35 x 60 s annealing    -> 2100 s
Modules        : denv1Detection, denv2Detection, denv3Detection, denv4Detection
Variable reuse : ssdna_amplicons reused across all four sensor branches (compiler accepted;
                 rename via mix with nf_water used as BioScript variable aliasing workaround)
drain vs dispose: BioScript IR collapses both to dispose(); drain is a routing hint for the
                 physical scheduler, not a distinct IR opcode (confirmed in compiled IR output)
CFG structure  : Linear diamond chain: main -> {BB2,BB3} -> BB4 -> {BB5,BB6} -> BB7 ->
                 {BB8,BB9} -> BB10 -> {BB11,BB12} -> BB13(NOP)

description:
PROTOCOL DESCRIPTION
====================

Title        : Characterizing Deformability and Electrical Properties of Breast Cancer Cells
               Using a Microfluidic Device Combining Electrical Impedance Sensing and
               Mechanical Constriction
Source Link  : https://pubs.acs.org/ancham/article/90/1/912/818332/Characterizing-Deformability-and-Electrical
Paper DOI    : https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.analchem.7b03859
Journal      : Analytical Chemistry, 2018, Vol. 90 (1), pp. 912–919
Authors      : Ying Zhou, Dahou Yang, Yinning Zhou, Bee Luan Khoo, Jongyoon Han, Ye Ai
Affiliations : BioSyM IRG, SMART Centre, Singapore; SUTD Singapore; MIT Cambridge MA
Platform     : Pressure-driven PDMS microfluidic device with integrated coplanar gold electrodes
               in differential impedance configuration; Fluigent MFCS-EZ pressure controller


OVERVIEW
--------
This protocol describes simultaneous characterisation of single-cell mechanical deformability
and electrical properties as cells transit a narrow PDMS constriction under applied pressure.
Four cell populations are compared: untreated MCF-7 (live breast cancer cells), PMA-modified
MCF-7 (modMCF-7, pharmacologically softened), formaldehyde-fixed MCF-7 (stiffened reference),
and red blood cells (RBCs, highly deformable positive reference).

The key innovation is a differential four-electrode-pair impedance configuration that
simultaneously measures:
  (1) Z_undeformed: electrical impedance of the intact cell before entering the constriction,
      captured by two outer electrode pairs positioned upstream/downstream of the constriction.
      This reflects cell size and membrane capacitance.
  (2) Z_deformed: electrical impedance of the fully deformed cell inside the constriction,
      captured by two inner electrode pairs inside the narrow channel. This is dominated by
      cell membrane electrical properties.

This is the first reported device to measure both Z_undeformed and Z_deformed in a single
transit event. Three mechanical timing parameters are also extracted per cell:
  - Passage time : total time from first contact with constriction to full exit
  - Entry time   : time for cell to enter and fully deform into the constriction
  - Transit time : time spent transiting the interior of the constriction

The differential configuration automatically rejects multi-cell transit events (identified
by successive same-sign impedance peaks) and is insensitive to environmental drift, unlike
conventional non-differential two-electrode approaches.


DEVICE ARCHITECTURE
-------------------
Channel fabrication:
  Photoresist : SU-8 2015 (MicroChem); spin-coated at 2000 rpm; thickness ~20 um
  Soft bake   : 65 C 1 min + 95 C 3 min
  UV exposure : 155 mJ/cm2
  Post bake   : 65 C 1 min + 95 C 3 min
  Developer   : SU-8 developer solution, room temperature
  Mold treat  : trichloro(1H,1H,2H,2H-perfluorooctyl)silane, vapor deposition (hydrophobic)
  PDMS        : Sylgard 184 (Dow Corning); base:curing agent 10:1; degas; pour on mold;
                cure 60 C ≥3 h; peel; punch inlets/outlets with 1.5 mm biopsy punch
  Channel height : ~20 um
  Constriction width : ~8 um (narrower than MCF-7 diameter ~22 um; forces deformation)

Electrode fabrication:
  Substrate   : 4 inch glass wafer
  Material    : Gold, patterned by lift-off process
  Width       : 20 um; spacing within pair: 30 um
  Configuration: Coplanar, patterned on bottom glass substrate (4 pairs total)
  Outer pairs : 2 pairs flanking constriction (sense undeformed cells)
  Inner pairs : 2 pairs inside constriction (sense fully deformed cells)

Bonding:
  Oxygen plasma treatment of PDMS and glass surfaces; align using XY positioner;
  bond permanently; bake 120 C 1 h to strengthen bond.

Impedance measurement:
  Analyser    : HF2IS Impedance Spectroscope (Zurich Instruments)
  Input V     : 500 mV amplitude
  Frequencies : 1 MHz and 2 MHz (simultaneous multi-frequency acquisition)
  Method      : Differential: ΔZ = (Z_medium_only − Z_cell+medium) / (Z_cell+medium × Z_medium_only)
  Advantage   : Eliminates baseline drift; rejects multi-cell events; does not require short/straight
                constriction geometry for detectable signal; measures both deformed and undeformed states

Electrical circuit model:
  Type        : Single-shell Foster-Schwan model
  Components  : Ri (cell interior resistance), Cmem (cell membrane capacitance),
                Rmed (medium resistance), Cmed (medium capacitance), CDL (double-layer capacitance)
  Assumptions : Cell interior capacitance and membrane resistance neglected (simplified analysis)
  Validated against impedance measurements from single cells (Sun & Morgan 2010; Morgan et al. 2006)

Pressure control:
  System      : Fluigent MFCS-EZ
  Application : Positive pressure at channel inlet drives cell flow
  Pressures   : 200 mbar (Figure S4) and 500 mbar (Figure 3 / Figure S3) tested


CELL LINES
----------
- MCF-7 (human breast adenocarcinoma): standard cancer cell deformability model.
  Cultured in standard conditions. Trypsinized and resuspended in PBS for live experiments.
  Average cell size: 22.01 um.

- modMCF-7 (PMA-modified MCF-7): MCF-7 treated with 500 nM PMA (Sigma-Aldrich) for 18 h at
  37 C. PMA activates protein kinase C (PKC), inducing cortical actin remodelling and
  increasing cell deformability. After treatment, cells resuspended in PBS for measurement.
  Average cell size: 22.42 um. Dose-response tested at 100, 300, 500 nM (Figure S6).

- fixedMCF-7 (formaldehyde-fixed MCF-7): MCF-7 fixed in 4% methanol-free formaldehyde
  (ThermoScientific) for 8 min; quenched with 0.127 M glycine for 5 min at room temperature;
  resuspended in PBS. Crosslinking maximally stiffens cytoskeleton. Average cell size: 23.37 um.

- RBC (human red blood cells): highly deformable positive reference. Biconcave disc ~8 um
  diameter. Readily transits 8 um constriction with minimal entry resistance. Resuspended in PBS.

Size note: All three MCF-7 populations show similar size distributions (avg 22–23 um),
confirming that observed differences in passage time and impedance reflect mechanical and
electrical properties, not size effects.


PROTOCOL STEPS
--------------

Step 1 | PMA Modification of MCF-7 Cells (modMCF-7 Preparation)
  Reagents    : MCF7_Cells, PMA_500nM (500 nM in PBS)
  Mix         : 5 s (cells + PMA combined)
  Heat        : 37 C for 18 h (1080 min = 64800 s)
  Wash        : Resuspend in PBS after treatment
  BioScript   : mix mcf7_for_mod with pmaReagent for 5s
                heat modTreatmentMix at 37c for 1080m
                mix modTreatmentMix with modWashPBS for 1m
  IR check    : heat(modTreatmentMix1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 64800.0SECOND ✓

Step 2 | Formaldehyde Fixation of MCF-7 Cells (fixedMCF-7 Preparation)
  Reagents    : MCF7_Cells, Formaldehyde_4pct (4% methanol-free, ThermoScientific),
                Glycine_127mM (0.127 M glycine quench solution)
  Fixation    : Mix cells with formaldehyde; incubate 8 min (480 s) at room temperature
  Quench      : Add glycine; incubate 5 min (300 s) at room temperature
  Wash        : Resuspend in PBS
  BioScript   : mix mcf7_for_fix with formaldehydeSoln for 8m
                mix fixationMix with glycineQuench for 5m
                mix quenchedFixation with fixWashPBS for 1m
  IR check    : fixationMix @ 480.0SECOND; quenchedFixation @ 300.0SECOND ✓

Step 3 | Channel Priming with 1% BSA in PBS
  Reagents    : BSA_PBS (1% BSA in PBS), PBS
  Duration    : 20 min (1200 s)
  Purpose     : Blocks hydrophobic PDMS surfaces; prevents non-specific MCF-7 cell adhesion
  BioScript   : mix primingBSA with primingPBS for 20m
  IR check    : primingMix @ 1200.0SECOND ✓

Step 4 | Untreated MCF-7 Cell Measurement at 500 mbar
  Reagents    : MCF7_Cells (live, trypsinized, in PBS), primed channel
  Pressure    : 500 mbar (Fluigent MFCS-EZ, positive pressure at inlet)
  Loading     : Cells flow continuously into device; `mix` abstracts pressure-driven
                channel loading (not a DMF droplet merge step)
  Detection   : impedanceDetection module, 30 s
                Outer electrode pairs: Z_undeformed per cell
                Inner electrode pairs: Z_deformed per cell
                Timing: passage time, entry time, transit time extracted from peak shape
  QC          : Differential sign-reversal check confirms single-cell events
                Multi-cell events (successive same-sign peaks) automatically rejected
  BioScript   : mcf7FlowMix = mix mcf7Live with primingMix for 2s
                impedanceSignal = detect impedanceDetection on mcf7FlowMix for 30s
  Results (500 mbar, Figure S3):
    Passage time  : MCF-7 mean 6.97 ms, modMCF-7 mean 6.0 ms  (N=885, 342)
    Entry time    : MCF-7 mean 1.68 ms, modMCF-7 mean 1.58 ms  (N=666, 460)
    Transit time  : MCF-7 mean 3.39 ms, modMCF-7 mean 3.17 ms  (N=747, 302)
  Branch:
    Pass (impedanceSignal > 0) -> BB2: dispose mcf7FlowMix
    Fail (impedanceSignal <= 0) -> BB3: drain mcf7FlowMix
    Join -> BB4

Step 5 | PMA-Modified MCF-7 (modMCF-7) Measurement at 500 mbar
  Reagents    : modMCF7_Ready (from Step 1), BSA_PBS (fresh priming)
  Pressure    : 500 mbar
  Detection   : impedanceDetection module, 30 s
  Expected    : Shorter passage/entry/transit times vs untreated MCF-7;
                lower Z_undeformed reflecting less resistive cell interior due to cortical actin loss
  BioScript   : modFlowMix = mix modMCF7_Ready with primingMix2 for 2s
                modSignal = detect impedanceDetection on modFlowMix for 30s
  Branch:
    Pass (modSignal > 0) -> BB5: dispose modFlowMix
    Fail (modSignal <= 0) -> BB6: drain modFlowMix
    Join -> BB7

Step 6 | Formaldehyde-Fixed MCF-7 Measurement at 500 mbar (and 200 mbar)
  Reagents    : fixedMCF7_Ready (from Step 2), BSA_PBS (fresh priming)
  Pressures   : 500 mbar (primary run) and 200 mbar (for Figure S4 four-population comparison)
  Detection   : impedanceDetection module, 30 s
  Expected    : Longest passage/entry/transit times of all four populations;
                maximum stiffness from cytoskeletal crosslinking; impedance dominated by
                membrane properties as cell cannot fully conform to constriction geometry
  BioScript   : fixedFlowMix = mix fixedMCF7_Ready with primingMix3 for 2s
                fixedSignal = detect impedanceDetection on fixedFlowMix for 30s
  Results (200 mbar, Figure S4):
    Population  | Passage (ms) | Entry (ms) | Transit (ms) | N (pass/entry/transit)
    RBC         |  9.21        |  2.32      |  4.21        | 264 / 481 / 477
    modMCF-7    | 16.7         |  4.88      |  8.75        | 277 / 580 / 260
    MCF-7       | 20.9         |  5.77      | 10.5         | 313 / 370 / 370
    fixedMCF-7  | 63.0         | 20.3       | 21.3         |  72 / 134 / 119
  Statistical test: Mann-Whitney; *** p < 0.001 for all pairwise comparisons
  Branch:
    Pass (fixedSignal > 0) -> BB8: dispose fixedFlowMix
    Fail (fixedSignal <= 0) -> BB9: drain fixedFlowMix
    Join -> BB10

Step 7 | RBC Reference Measurement with Optical Validation (200 mbar and 500 mbar)
  Reagents    : RBC_Cells (in PBS), BSA_PBS (fresh priming)
  Pressures   : 200 mbar and 500 mbar

protocol.title: Characterizing Deformability and Electrical Properties of Breast Cancer Cells Using a Microfluidic Device Combining Electrical Impedance Sensing and Mechanical Constriction
protocol.platform: Pressure-driven PDMS microfluidic device with integrated coplanar gold electrodes (differential impedance configuration)
cell_lines: modMCF-7 (MCF-7 treated with 500 nM PMA for 18 h, increased deformability)
fixedMCF-7 (MCF-7 fixed with 4% methanol-free formaldehyde, stiffened)
RBC (human red blood cells, highly deformable reference)
protocol.objective: Simultaneous characterisation of single-cell mechanical deformability (passage time, entry time, transit time) and electrical properties (impedance of undeformed and deformed cells) as cells are driven through an 8 um wide constriction under applied pressure

fabrication.bonding: oxygen plasma treatment; PDMS-glass alignment with XY positioner; bake 120 C 1 h

electrodes.configuration: coplanar, patterned on bottom glass substrate
electrodes.design: differential; outer pairs sense undeformed cells, inner pairs sense fully deformed cells

advantage_over_nondifferential: Measures both undeformed and deformed cell impedance in same transit event
Automatically rejects multi-cell transit events via sign-reversal peak check
Insensitive to environmental drift in channel
Not limited to short straight constrictions for signal detectability

pma_reagent.name: Phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate (PMA)
pma_reagent.effect: Activates PKC; remodels cortical actin; increases cell deformability

modMCF7.preparation: treat with 500 nM PMA 18 h at 37 C, then resuspend in PBS

fixedMCF7.preparation: fix in 4% methanol-free formaldehyde 8 min; quench with 0.127 M glycine 5 min; resuspend in PBS

cell_preparation.size_note: All three MCF-7 populations show similar size distributions (avg 22-23 um); size is not a confounding variable in deformability comparison

steps.name: PMA modification of MCF-7 cells (modMCF-7 preparation)
steps.notes: PMA activates protein kinase C, inducing cortical actin remodelling and increasing deformability. Treated at 500 nM (dose-response also tested at 100 nM and 300 nM; see Figure S6).

steps.name: Formaldehyde fixation of MCF-7 cells (fixedMCF-7 preparation)
steps.notes: Methanol-free formaldehyde preserves membrane integrity while crosslinking cytoskeleton. Glycine quenches unreacted aldehyde groups.

steps.name: Channel priming with 1% BSA in PBS
steps.purpose: Blocks hydrophobic PDMS surfaces to prevent non-specific cell adhesion to channel walls
steps.notes: Positive pressure applied at inlet via Fluigent MFCS-EZ to flow priming solution through channel.

steps.name: Untreated MCF-7 cell measurement (500 mbar)
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection
steps.flow_abstraction: mix abstracted as pressure-driven channel loading event (not DMF merge)

measured_parameters.Z_undeformed: impedance of cell in suspension before entering constriction (outer electrode pairs); reflects cell size and membrane capacitance
measured_parameters.Z_deformed: impedance of cell fully deformed inside constriction (inner electrode pairs); dominated by cell membrane electrical properties

pass.note: Valid bipolar peak pair detected: single-cell confirmed by differential sign-reversal

fail.note: Invalid event: multi-cell transit or no cell; successive same-sign peaks flag multi-cell

steps.name: PMA-modified MCF-7 cell measurement (500 mbar)
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection
steps.expected_result: Shorter passage/entry/transit times vs untreated MCF-7; lower impedance of undeformed cell reflecting increased deformability

steps.name: Formaldehyde-fixed MCF-7 cell measurement (500 mbar and 200 mbar)
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection
steps.statistical_test: Mann-Whitney; *** p < 0.001 for all pairwise comparisons
steps.expected_result: Longest passage/entry/transit times of all populations; maximum stiffness from cytoskeletal crosslinking

steps.name: RBC reference measurement (200 mbar and 500 mbar) with optical validation
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection + optical passage-time validation
steps.optical_instrument: Phantom v9.1 high-speed camera (Vision Research), 1000 fps
steps.expected_result: Shortest passage/entry/transit times (RBC ~8 um diameter, highly deformable biconcave disc); optical and impedance timing measurements cross-validated

pass.note: Valid RBC transit confirmed by both impedance peak and optical frame analysis

pma_dose_response.description: Figure S6: MCF-7 treated with 100 nM, 300 nM, 500 nM PMA vs untreated control
pma_dose_response.conclusion: 500 nM selected as optimal concentration for maximum deformability increase with consistent impedance shift

multi_cell_rejection.rule: Single-cell transit: one positive peak followed by one negative peak (or vice versa). Multiple cells: successive same-sign peaks.
multi_cell_rejection.advantage: Conventional non-differential 2-electrode measurement cannot distinguish multi-cell events; falsely records as single large cell
